name: Stepper motors
summary: Motors that move in precise steps: printers, scanners, 3D printers and CNC machines.
uses: Precise positioning for CNC and solar trackers
Hand-crank generators (they make AC when spun)
Slow, controlled drives for valves and dampers
identify: Square-flanged motors with four, five or six wires: NEMA 17 and 23 in 3D printers, CNC machines and big printers; small round 28BYJ-48s in air conditioner louvres and toys; tiny ones in floppy and optical drives.
test: Find the coil pairs with a meter (a few ohms each). Spin the shaft with a pair shorted and it goes stiff; spun open, each coil gives AC volts.
